events.title: Flow Yoga
events.description:
In this class we will work our body and mind.
Always introducing a theme to have in mind throughout class.
It will be physically challenging but always with easier options so that all levels can enjoy 💫
Quality matts provided and no need to bring anything 🙏🏼
The classes will be taught in either danish og english depending on participants.
Location
Tranderupgade 53
Walk behind main house and behind the big barn you will find the Yoga Studio
If problems contact me on instagram or phone 41411141
